parsed.post: Discarding the depth 8 run on 0-9 (0.996097) as it is worse than the previous clean best. It seems depth 8 might need a different learning rate or warmup to stabilize without the shard-10 boost. Reverting to the last clean best b406993 (contaminated, but used as reference) and pivoting to test WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 on depth 8/0-9.
parsed.description: Testing DEPTH=8 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 on clean 0-9 shards to see if higher warmup and capacity improve performance without shard-10 contamination.
